questions.en: A pipe can fill a water tank in 8 hours, but due to a leakage in the bottom it takes 10 hours to fill it. If the tank is completely full, in how many hours will the leakage empty the full tank?
questions.hi: एक नल किसी पानी की टंकी को 8 घंटे में भर सकता है, परन्तु तली में रिसाव के कारण इसे भरने में 10 घंटे लगते हैं। यदि टंकी पूरी भरी हो, तो वह रिसाव पूरी टंकी को कितने घंटे में खाली कर देगा?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Inflow rate = 1/8 tank/hr. Net inflow with leak = 1/10 tank/hr. Leakage rate = 1/8 - 1/10 = (5 - 4)/40 = 1/40 tank/hr. Time to empty full tank = 40 hours.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Leak formula: (A * B) / (B - A) = (8 * 10) / (10 - 8) = 80 / 2 = 40 hours.

questions.en: The electric power consumed by an incandescent lamp rated 220 V, 100 W when operated on an electric supply of 110 V is
questions.hi: 220 V, 100 W अंकित एक विद्युत बल्ब को जब 110 V की विद्युत आपूर्ति पर चलाया जाता है, तो इसके द्वारा उपभुक्त विद्युत शक्ति क्या होगी?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Resistance of filament = V^2 / P = (220)^2 / 100 = 48400 / 100 = 484 Ω. When operated at V' = 110 V, Power P' = (V')^2 / R = (110)^2 / 484 = 12100 / 484 = 25 W.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: When voltage is halved (220V to 110V), power becomes (1/2)^2 = 1/4th of rated power = 100 / 4 = 25 W.

questions.en: Why does the clear sky appear blue during daytime?
questions.hi: दिन के समय स्वच्छ आकाश का रंग नीला क्यों दिखाई देता है?
options: Rayleigh scattering of shorter blue wavelengths of light by air molecules
Absorption of red light by water vapor
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Rayleigh scattering of shorter blue wavelengths of light by air moleculesDetailed
questions.explanation: According to Rayleigh scattering law, intensity of scattered light varies inversely as the fourth power of wavelength (I ∝ 1/λ^4). Because blue light has a shorter wavelength than red light, it is scattered much more strongly by fine gas molecules in the upper atmosphere.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Blue sky = Rayleigh Scattering (I ∝ 1/λ^4); Red sunrise/sunset = Scattering of longer wavelengths; Clouds appear white = Mie scattering.

questions.en: Which chemical element in the periodic table has the highest electronegativity value on the Pauling scale?(
questions.hi: आवर्त सारणी में पॉलिंग पैमाने पर किस रासायनिक तत्व की विद्युत ऋणात्मकता (Electronegativity) सर्वाधिक होती है?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Fluorine (F, atomic number 9) has the highest electronegativity of 4.0 on the Pauling scale due to its small atomic size and high effective nuclear charge. Oxygen (3.5) and Chlorine (3.0) are second and third.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Highest Electronegativity = Fluorine (4.0); Highest Electron Affinity = Chlorine.

questions.en: Which hormone is secreted by the adrenal medulla during stress or fear, preparing the body for 'Fight or Flight' response?(
questions.hi: तनाव या भय की स्थिति में अधिवृक्क मज्जा (Adrenal Medulla) से कौन-सा हार्मोन स्रावित होता है जो शरीर को 'लड़ो या भागो' (Fight or Flight) प्रतिक्रिया के लिए तैयार करता है?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Adrenaline (epinephrine) increases heart rate, dilates bronchioles, elevates blood pressure, and stimulates glycogenolysis in the liver to release glucose rapidly into the bloodstream during acute emergencies.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Emergency hormone / 3F hormone (Fight, Flight, Fright) = Adrenaline.

questions.en: What is the normal physiological pH range of arterial human blood?(
questions.hi: मानव धमनी रक्त का सामान्य शारीरिक pH परास (Range) क्या होता है?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Human blood is slightly alkaline, tightly regulated between pH 7.35 and 7.45 by the carbonic acid-bicarbonate buffer system (H2CO3 / HCO3-) and respiratory compensation by the lungs.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Human blood pH = 7.35 to 7.45 (slightly alkaline).

questions.en: Following the martyrdom of Babu Kunwar Singh in April 1858, who led the guerrilla resistance against the British in the dense forests of the Kaimur hills?
questions.hi: अप्रैल 1858 में बाबू कुंवर सिंह के बलिदान के बाद कैमूर की पहाड़ियों के घने जंगलों में अंग्रेजों के विरुद्ध छापामार युद्ध का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Babu Amar Singh, younger brother of Kunwar Singh, established a parallel revolutionary administration in the Kaimur hills and Shahabad forests, maintaining fierce guerrilla resistance against British columns until late 1859.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Guerrilla resistance in Kaimur after Kunwar Singh = Amar Singh.

questions.en: Mahatma Gandhi presided over the annual session of the Indian National Congress only once. Where and in which year was this historic session held?
questions.hi: महात्मा गांधी ने केवल एक बार भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के वार्षिक अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की थी। यह ऐतिहासिक अधिवेशन कहाँ और किस वर्ष आयोजित हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi presided over the 39th Session of the Indian National Congress at Belgaum (now Belagavi, Karnataka) in December 1924. This was the only INC session ever presided over by Gandhi.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Only Congress session presided by Mahatma Gandhi = 1924 Belgaum Session (Karnataka).

questions.en: Who was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly of India on 11 December 1946?
questions.hi: 11 दिसंबर 1946 को भारत की संविधान सभा का स्थायी अध्यक्ष किसे चुना गया था?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha served as the temporary interim chairman on 9 December 1946. On 11 December 1946, Dr. Rajendra Prasad was unanimously elected permanent President of the Constituent Assembly.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Temporary Chairman (9 Dec 1946) = Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha; Permanent President (11 Dec 1946) = Dr. Rajendra Prasad.

questions.en: Who served as the prominent editor of the nationalist English daily newspaper 'The Searchlight' published from Patna during the freedom movement?
questions.hi: स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन के दौरान पटना से प्रकाशित राष्ट्रवादी अंग्रेजी दैनिक समाचार पत्र 'द सर्चलाइट' के प्रमुख संपादक कौन रहे?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Founded in 1918 by Dr. Rajendra Prasad and Sachchidananda Sinha, 'The Searchlight' was edited with great patriotic distinction by Murli Manohar Prasad for decades, championing civil disobedience and peasant causes in Bihar.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: 'The Searchlight' editor = Murli Manohar Prasad; 'The Motherland' founder = Mazharul Haque.

questions.en: In response to the Birsa Munda Ulgulan (Rebellion), which protective agrarian tenancy legislation was enacted by the British administration in 1908?(
questions.hi: बिरसा मुंडा के उलगुलान (विद्रोह) के परिणामस्वरूप 1908 में ब्रिटिश प्रशासन द्वारा कौन-सा सुरक्षात्मक कृषि काश्तकारी कानून पारित किया गया था?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Enacted on 11 November 1908, the Chhotanagpur Tenancy Act (CNT Act) legally recognized the Khuntkatti (joint tribal ownership) rights of Mundas, banned beth-begari (forced unpaid labour), and strictly prohibited the transfer of tribal land to non-tribals.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Chhotanagpur Tenancy Act passed = 1908 (Direct result of Birsa Munda's revolt).

questions.en: In which decisive battle fought on 22 October 1764 did the British East India Company forces under Major Hector Munro defeat the combined armies of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, and Emperor Shah Alam II?
questions.hi: 22 अक्टूबर 1764 को लड़े गए किस निर्णायक युद्ध में मेजर हेक्टर मुनरो के नेतृत्व में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी की सेना ने मीर कासिम, शुजाउद्दौला और शाह आलम द्वितीय की संयुक्त सेना को पराजित किया था?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The Battle of Buxar established sovereign British administrative supremacy over northern India, leading directly to the Treaty of Allahabad (1765) granting Diwani rights of Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa to Robert Clive.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Battle of Buxar = 22 October 1764 (Major Hector Munro vs Mir Qasim + Shuja-ud-Daula + Shah Alam II).

questions.en: Under which Article of the Constitution of India can the Parliament abolish an existing State Legislative Council or create one if the Legislative Assembly of the State passes a resolution to that effect?(
questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत यदि राज्य की विधानसभा संकल्प पारित करे, तो संसद किसी राज्य में विधान परिषद का सृजन या उत्सादन (समाप्ति) कर सकती है?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Article 169 deals with the abolition or creation of Legislative Councils in States. The Legislative Assembly must pass a resolution by a special majority (majority of total membership and not less than 2/3rds present and voting), following which Parliament may enact a simple law.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Creation or Abolition of Legislative Council = Article 169; Composition of Council = Article 171.

questions.en: Which three words were added to the Preamble of the Constitution of India by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976?
questions.hi: 1976 के 42वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना में कौन-से तीन शब्द जोड़े गए थे?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment amended the opening description from 'Sovereign Democratic Republic' to 'Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic', and changed 'unity of the Nation' to 'unity and integrity of the Nation'.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: 42nd Amendment 1976 added 3 words: Socialist, Secular, Integrity. (Preamble amended only once).

questions.en: 'Bihar Diwas' (बिहार दिवस) is officially celebrated every year on which date to commemorate the creation of the State of Bihar?
questions.hi: बिहार राज्य के गठन की स्मृति में प्रतिवर्ष किस तिथि को आधिकारिक रूप से 'बिहार दिवस' मनाया जाता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Bihar Diwas is celebrated annually on 22 March to mark the day in 1912 when the British government issued the official notification carving the Province of Bihar and Orissa out of the Bengal Presidency.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Bihar Diwas = 22 March (Notification of 1912 separation from Bengal).

questions.en: In the flagship 'Saat Nischay-2' (2020-25) scheme of the Government of Bihar, which initiative is specifically aimed at promoting youth entrepreneurship and skill development?(
questions.hi: बिहार सरकार की महत्वाकांक्षी योजना 'सात निश्चय-2' (2020-25) के तहत कौन-सा निश्चय विशेष रूप से युवा उद्यमिता और कौशल विकास से संबंधित है?)
options: Yuva Shakti - Bihar Ki Pragati (युवा शक्ति - बिहार की प्रगति)
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Yuva Shakti - Bihar Ki Pragati (युवा शक्ति - बिहार की प्रगति)Detailed
questions.explanation: The first initiative under Saat Nischay-2 is 'Yuva Shakti - Bihar Ki Pragati', which provides ₹5 lakh grant + ₹5 lakh loan at 1% interest (0% for women) under the Mukhya Mantri Udyami Yojana.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Saat Nischay-2 components: 1. Yuva Shakti, 2. Sashakt Mahila, 3. Har Khet Ko Pani, 4. Swachh Gaon, 5. Swachh Shahar, 6. Sulabh Samparkata, 7. Sabke Liye Swasthya Suvidha.

questions.en: If a clock strikes once at 1 o'clock, twice at 2 o'clock, and so on, how many times will it strike in total in a 12-hour period?
questions.hi: यदि एक घड़ी 1 बजे 1 बार, 2 बजे 2 बार और इसी प्रकार बजती है, तो 12 घंटे की अवधि में वह कुल कितनी बार बजेगी?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Sum of first 12 natural numbers = n(n + 1)/2 = 12 * 13 / 2 = 78 strikes. In a full 24-hour day, it strikes 78 * 2 = 156 times.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Sum = 1 + 2 + ... + 12 = 12 * 13 / 2 = 78 times in 12 hours.

questions.en: The product of two positive integers is 2,028 and their HCF is 13. How many such pairs of numbers are possible?(
questions.hi: दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों का गुणनफल 2,028 है और उनका म०स० (HCF) 13 है। ऐसी संख्याओं के कितने युग्म (Pairs) संभव हैं?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be 13a and 13b, where a and b are co-prime. Product = 13a * 13b = 169ab = 2028 => ab = 2028 / 169 = 12. Co-prime pairs whose product is 12: (1, 12) and (3, 4). (Note: (2, 6) are not co-prime). Thus, exactly 2 pairs are possible: (13, 156) and (39, 52).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: ab = 2028 / 13^2 = 12. Co-prime factor pairs of 12 = (1, 12) and (3, 4) => exactly 2 pairs.

questions.en: Which chemical property makes Plaster of Paris set into a hard solid mass within minutes of mixing with water?
questions.hi: पानी मिलाने पर प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस किस रासायनिक अभिक्रिया के कारण कुछ ही मिनटों में एक कठोर ठोस पिंड में बदल जाता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: On mixing with water, Plaster of Paris (CaSO4 · 1/2H2O) undergoes an exothermic hydration reaction, recombining with 1.5 molecules of water to reform gypsum (CaSO4 · 2H2O), which crystallizes into an interlocking needle-like hard network.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: POP setting = Rehydration back to Gypsum (CaSO4 · 2H2O).

questions.en: Who among the following was the founder-leader of the 'Azad Dasta' (आजाद दस्ता) guerrilla organization formed in the jungles of Nepal during the Quit India Movement 1942?
questions.hi: 1942 के भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के दौरान नेपाल के जंगलों में 'आजाद दस्ता' नामक छापामार संगठन का गठन किसने किया था?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: After escaping from Hazaribagh Central Jail on Diwali night in November 1942, Jayaprakash Narayan established the Azad Dasta training camp in the Bakro ka Tapu area of Nepal's Terai to impart armed guerrilla training and sabotage communications.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Azad Dasta (Nepal, 1942) = Jayaprakash Narayan (JP); Escaped from Hazaribagh Jail.

questions.en: Which river is known as the 'Narayani' and 'Saptagandaki' in the Nepal Himalayas before entering the territory of Bihar at Valmikinagar?
questions.hi: नेपाल हिमालय में किस नदी को 'नारायणी' और 'सप्तगंडकी' के नाम से जाना जाता है, जो वाल्मीकिनगर से बिहार में प्रवेश करती है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The Gandak River (known in Nepal as the Saligrami or Narayani) enters Bihar at Valmikinagar in West Champaran and forms the boundary between Bihar and UP before discharging into the Ganga at Sonpur/Hajipur.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Gandak = Narayani / Saptagandaki; enters Bihar at Valmikinagar (West Champaran); famous for Saligram stones.

questions.en: What is the total geographical forest cover in the State of Bihar as per the India State of Forest Report (ISFR) 2021?(
questions.hi: भारत वन स्थिति रिपोर्ट (ISFR) 2021 के अनुसार, बिहार राज्य में कुल भौगोलिक वनावरण (Forest Cover) कितना है?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: According to ISFR 2021, the recorded forest cover of Bihar is 7,380.79 sq km, which constitutes 7.84% of the State's total geographical area (94,163 sq km). Kaimur district has the highest forest cover (31.56%).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Forest Cover of Bihar = 7.84% (ISFR 2021); District with highest forest % = Kaimur (31.56%).

questions.en: Which Constitutional Article mandates that there shall be an independent Election Commission of India for superintendence, direction, and control of elections?
questions.hi: संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद यह अनिवार्य करता है कि चुनावों के अधीक्षण, निर्देशन और नियंत्रण के लिए भारत का एक स्वतंत्र निर्वाचन आयोग होगा?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Article 324 provides for the establishment of the Election Commission of India to conduct elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President. Elections to Panchayats are conducted by State Election Commissions under Article 243K.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Election Commission of India = Article 324; Adult Suffrage = Article 326; State Election Commission (Panchayats) = Article 243K.

questions.en: In which year was the 'National Education Policy (NEP) 2020' approved by the Union Cabinet of India, replacing the 1986 education policy?(1986
questions.hi: की शिक्षा नीति को प्रतिस्थापित करते हुए भारत के केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा 'राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020' को किस वर्ष मंजूरी दी गई थी?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Drafted by a committee headed by Dr. K. Kasturirangan, NEP 2020 was approved on 29 July 2020. It replaced the previous 10+2 system with a new 5+3+3+4 pedagogical structure covering foundational to secondary school stages.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: NEP 2020: Committee Chairman = Dr. K. Kasturirangan; Structure = 5+3+3+4; Approved = 29 July 2020.

questions.en: If the perimeter of a circular garden is equal to the perimeter of a square garden, then what is the ratio of their respective areas?
questions.hi: यदि किसी वृत्ताकार बगीचे का परिमाप एक वर्गाकार बगीचे के परिमाप के बराबर है, तो उनके क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात क्या होगा?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Perimeter of circle = 2πr. Perimeter of square = 4a. Given 2πr = 4a => a = (πr)/2. Area of circle = πr^2. Area of square = a^2 = (π^2 r^2)/4. Ratio = (πr^2) / [(π^2 r^2)/4] = 4/π = 4 / (22/7) = 28/22 = 14/11.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Ratio of Area(Circle) to Area(Square) when perimeters are equal is always 14 : 11.

questions.en: In which year was the 'All India Kisan Sabha' (AIKS) founded at the Lucknow session of the Congress with Swami Sahajanand Saraswati as President?(
questions.hi: कांग्रेस के लखनऊ अधिवेशन में किस वर्ष स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती की अध्यक्षता में 'अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा' (AIKS) की स्थापना हुई थी?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The All India Kisan Sabha was established on 11 April 1936 at the Lucknow Congress session. Swami Sahajanand Saraswati was elected President and Prof. N. G. Ranga was appointed General Secretary.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha = 1929 (Sonepur); All India Kisan Sabha = 1936 (Lucknow).

questions.en: Which district in Bihar borders both the State of West Bengal and the international border of the country of Nepal?
questions.hi: बिहार का कौन-सा जिला पश्चिम बंगाल राज्य और नेपाल देश दोनों के साथ सीमा साझा करता है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Kishanganj, located at the eastern tip of Bihar (part of the Siliguri corridor area), borders Nepal to its north and West Bengal (Darjeeling and Uttar Dinajpur districts) to its east.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Borders both Nepal and West Bengal = Kishanganj; Borders both Nepal and UP = West Champaran.

questions.en: What is the primary function of the enzyme 'Pepsin' secreted in the human stomach?
questions.hi: मानव आमाशय में स्रावित होने वाले एंजाइम 'पेप्सिन' का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
options: Digestion of dietary proteins into peptones and proteoses in an acidic medium
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Digestion of dietary proteins into peptones and proteoses in an acidic mediumDetailed
questions.explanation: Gastric chief cells secrete pepsinogen, which is activated into pepsin by hydrochloric acid (HCl, pH ~1.5 to 2.0). Pepsin cleaves complex dietary proteins into shorter peptides (proteoses and peptones).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Protein digestion enzymes: Stomach (acidic) = Pepsin; Pancreas/Small intestine (alkaline) = Trypsin.

questions.en: Which fundamental law of inheritance discovered by Gregor Mendel states that allele pairs separate independently during gamete formation?
questions.hi: ग्रेगर मेंडल द्वारा खोजा गया आनुवंशिकता का कौन-सा नियम बताता है कि युग्मक निर्माण के दौरान एलील के जोड़े एक-दूसरे से स्वतंत्र रूप से अलग होते हैं?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Mendel's Law of Independent Assortment states that alleles of two or more different genes get sorted into gametes independently of one another, demonstrated by the classic 9:3:3:1 dihybrid phenotypic ratio.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Monohybrid phenotypic ratio = 3:1 (Law of Segregation); Dihybrid phenotypic ratio = 9:3:3:1 (Law of Independent Assortment).

questions.en: During the 1857 Revolt in Bihar, which three regiments of the Native Infantry stationed at Danapur Cantonment revolted on 25 July 1857 and marched to Arrah?
questions.hi: 1857 के विद्रोह के दौरान दानापुर छावनी में तैनात देशी इन्फैंट्री की किन तीन रेजीमेंटों ने 25 जुलाई 1857 को विद्रोह किया और आरा की ओर कूच किया?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: On 25 July 1857, the sepoy soldiers of the 7th, 8th, and 40th Native Infantry regiments at Danapur revolted against General Lloyd, crossed the Son River, and joined Babu Kunwar Singh at Jagdishpur/Arrah.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Danapur mutiny regiments = 7th, 8th, and 40th Native Infantry (25 July 1857).

questions.en: In the Battle of Plassey (1757), Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah was betrayed by which commander-in-chief of his armed forces?(
questions.hi: प्लासी के युद्ध (1757) में नवाब सिराजुद्दौला के साथ उसके किस प्रधान सेनापति ने विश्वासघात किया था?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: In the Battle of Plassey on 23 June 1757, Mir Jafar (Mir Bakshi) conspired with Robert Clive and kept the major portion of the Nawab's troops standing inactive on the battlefield, leading to Siraj-ud-Daulah's defeat.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Battle of Plassey (23 June 1757) = Robert Clive vs Siraj-ud-Daulah; Traitor = Mir Jafar.

questions.en: Who introduced the system of 'Permanent Settlement' (
questions.hi: इस्तमरारी बंदोबस्त) of land revenue in Bengal and Bihar in 1793?(1793 में बंगाल और बिहार में भू-राजस्व की 'स्थायी बंदोबस्त' (इस्तमरारी बंदोबस्त) प्रणाली किसने लागू की थी?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Lord Cornwallis enacted the Permanent Settlement in 1793 in Bengal and Bihar with John Shore. Zamindars were recognized as owners of the land with fixed revenue dues (10/11th to British Company, 1/11th to Zamindar).💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Permanent Settlement (1793) = Lord Cornwallis (Bengal, Bihar, Orissa); Ryotwari = Thomas Munro; Mahalwari = Holt Mackenzie.

questions.en: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the appointment of the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India, designated as the guardian of the public purse?(
questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद भारत के नियंत्रक एवं महालेखापरीक्षक (CAG) की नियुक्ति का प्रावधान करता है, जिसे सार्वजनिक धन का संरक्षक कहा जाता है?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Article 148 establishes an independent CAG of India appointed by the President. Under Article 149 and 151, the CAG audits all accounts related to expenditure from the Consolidated Fund of India and submits reports to Parliament and State Legislatures.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: CAG of India = Article 148; Term = 6 years or 65 years of age; Guardian of Public Purse.

questions.en: In which year was the 'Bihar Panchayati Raj Act' enacted, making Bihar the first State in India to provide 50% reservation for women in all tiers of Panchayati Raj institutions?
questions.hi: किस वर्ष 'बिहार पंचायती राज अधिनियम' लागू किया गया, जिसके तहत पंचायती राज संस्थाओं के सभी स्तरों पर महिलाओं को 50% आरक्षण देने वाला बिहार भारत का पहला राज्य बना?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Under the leadership of Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, the Bihar Panchayati Raj Act 2006 was enacted, reserving 50% of all elected seats and office-bearer positions for women in Gram Panchayats, Panchayat Samitis, and Zilla Parishads.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: 50% Women Reservation in Panchayats = Bihar Panchayati Raj Act 2006 (First state in India).

questions.en: Which national highway connects Purnia, Saharsa, and Muzaffarpur across northern Bihar, serving as the East-West corridor arterial highway?(
questions.hi: उत्तर बिहार में पूर्णिया, सहरसा और मुजफ्फरपुर को जोड़ने वाला कौन-सा राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग पूर्व-पश्चिम गलियारे (East-West Corridor) का मुख्य मार्ग है?)
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: National Highway 27 is the second longest national highway in India, connecting Porbandar in Gujarat to Silchar in Assam. In Bihar, it traverses Gopalganj, Motihari, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Jhanjharpur, Supaul, and Purnia as the 4-lane East-West Corridor.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: East-West Corridor through North Bihar = NH 27 (Old NH 28 & 31).

questions.en: What is the name of the comprehensive welfare mission initiated by the Government of Bihar providing tap water connections to every rural household?
questions.hi: बिहार सरकार द्वारा ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के प्रत्येक घर में नल का स्वच्छ जल उपलब्ध कराने हेतु शुरू किए गए महत्वाकांक्षी निश्चय का क्या नाम है?
options: Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal (हर घर नल का जल)
More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal (हर घर नल का जल)Detailed
questions.explanation: Launched in 2016 under Saat Nischay-1 and continued under Saat Nischay-2, 'Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal' aims to provide piped potable drinking water to all households in Bihar without discrimination.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Piped tap water scheme in Bihar = Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal (Saat Nischay).

questions.en: Which wildlife sanctuary in Bihar is recognized as the largest wildlife sanctuary in the State by territorial area?
questions.hi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से बिहार का सबसे बड़ा वन्यजीव अभयारण्य कौन-सा है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary, situated in Kaimur and Rohtas districts over the Vindhyan plateau, covers an area of approx. 1,504.96 sq km, making it the largest wildlife sanctuary in Bihar.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Largest Wildlife Sanctuary in Bihar = Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary (1,505 sq km); Only National Park = Valmiki National Park.

questions.en: Who among the following was the founder-leader of the 'Wahhabi Movement' in India during the early 19th century, making Patna its premier organizational centre?
questions.hi: 19वीं शताब्दी के पूर्वार्ध में भारत में 'वहाबी आंदोलन' के संस्थापक-नेता कौन थे, जिन्होंने पटना को इसका प्रमुख संगठनात्मक केंद्र बनाया?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.answer_text: More than one of the aboveDetailed
questions.explanation: Syed Ahmad of Rae Bareli founded the movement in India. When he visited Patna in 1821, he appointed Maulvi Wilayat Ali and Maulvi Inayat Ali as his chief khalifas (deputies), who organized Sadikpur (Patna) as the vital logistical and financial headquarters of the Wahhabi movement. Because all three were paramount leaders, (D) is the official key.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Wahhabi Movement in Patna: Founder in India = Syed Ahmad Barelvi; Patna operational leaders = Wilayat Ali & Inayat Ali. Triggers Option (D).

questions.en: Which constitutional amendment act abolished the 'Right to Property' as a Fundamental Right and relocated it as a legal right under Article 300A?
questions.hi: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा 'संपत्ति के अधिकार' को मौलिक अधिकारों की सूची से हटाकर अनुच्छेद 300A के तहत एक कानूनी अधिकार बना दिया गया?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation: The 44th Constitutional Amendment Act 1978 enacted by the Janata Party government under Morarji Desai deleted Article 19(1)(f) and Article 31 from Part III and inserted Article 300A in Part XII, converting property into a non-fundamental legal/constitutional right.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Right to Property deleted from Fundamental Rights = 44th Amendment 1978 (now Article 300A).

questions.en: What is the approximate total geographical area of the State of Bihar?
questions.hi: बिहार राज्य का कुल भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल लगभग कितना है?
options: More than one of the above

None of the above
✔ Official Answer
questions.explanation:
The total geographical area of Bihar is 94,163 sq km (approx. 2.86% of India's total geographical area), ranking it as the 12th largest State in India by territory.💡 Exam Setter's Tips & Quick Tricks: Total Area of Bihar = 94,163 sq km (2.86% of India's land area; 12th in area, 3rd in population).
